args.code: (() => { const els = document.querySelectorAll("*"); const candidates = []; for (let i=0; i<els.length && candidates.length<10; i++) { if (els[i].textContent && (els[i].textContent.includes("跳过") || els[i].textContent.includes("继续") || els[i].textContent.includes("开始") || els[i].textContent.includes("选择") || els[i].textContent.includes("模式"))) { candidates.push({tag: els[i].tagName, class: els[i].className, id: els[i].id, text: els[i].textContent.trim().slice(0,50)}); } } return JSON.stringify(candidates); })()
